content.user_title: Generate Project Images with Google Gemini
content.value_statement: Projects often need custom visuals for interfaces, documentation, and design work. This skill provides a Google Gemini workflow for creating and saving PNG assets.
actual_capabilities: Recognizes requests for images, icons, logos, placeholders, diagrams, and visual concepts.
Provides command examples for generating images from text prompts.
Documents custom output paths and a 2K size option.
Defines PNG as the expected generated image format.
Describes image workflows for frontend development, documentation, and UI assets.
limitations: The package includes only instructions; the referenced generation script is absent.
Generation requires external Google Gemini access and a user-provided API key.
The documented workflow supports PNG output and does not describe image editing.
Generated visuals require human review for accuracy, text quality, licensing, and brand fit.

use_cases.title: Create Interface Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate hero images, placeholders, icons, and other visual assets for application interfaces.

use_cases.title: Illustrate Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Create diagrams and concept illustrations for guides, README files, and architecture documentation.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Produce visual directions for early design reviews, prototypes, and asset planning.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Placeholder
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PNG placeholder for [component] using [dimensions], [colors], and a simple [subject]. Save it to [path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with one clearly defined interface asset.

prompt_templates.title: Illustrate a Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a documentation illustration of [concept] with clear labels, high contrast, and a [style] layout. Save it to [path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a focused visual for technical documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Consistent Asset Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three UI assets for [product]: [asset list]. Match [brand colors], use [style], and save them under [directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce several related assets with consistent visual direction.

prompt_templates.title: Compose a Production Hero
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 2K hero image for [product]. Leave readable space on [side], exclude [elements], and save it to [path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Control composition, resolution, exclusions, and placement for a final interface.

output_examples.input: Create a minimal music player icon with a dark background and cyan controls.
output_examples.output: A PNG icon is saved at the requested path and is ready for interface review.

output_examples.input: Create a labeled microservices architecture illustration for the project documentation.
output_examples.output: A PNG architecture illustration is saved for review before publication.

output_examples.input: Generate a 2K abstract technology hero image with open space on the left.
output_examples.output: A 2K PNG hero image is saved with the requested composition and open text area.

best_practices: Specify the subject, dimensions, composition, colors, style, and intended use.
Choose an explicit output path that matches the project asset structure.
Review every image for accuracy, text rendering, accessibility, licensing, and brand consistency.
anti_patterns: Do not expose the Gemini API key in prompts, commands, logs, or generated files.
Do not request protected brands or copyrighted styles without confirming usage rights.
Do not publish generated text, labels, or diagrams without checking their accuracy.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: The documented workflow requires GEMINI_API_KEY to be set in the environment.

faq.question: Which image format does the skill produce?
faq.answer: The skill documents PNG as its output format.

faq.question: Can I choose the output location?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a custom path, or use the current directory as the documented default.

faq.question: Can I request higher resolution?
faq.answer: The usage example documents a 2K size option.

faq.question: Does this package include the generation script?
faq.answer: No. SKILL.md references scripts/generate_image.py, but that file is not included in this package.

faq.question: Does the workflow support image editing?
faq.answer: No editing workflow is documented. The instructions cover generating new PNG images from text prompts.
